scientific_integrity: The infinite formula is proved by rank and unique-zero-run arguments, not extrapolated from computations. Source implications and residual priority risk are recorded in AUDIT.json.
scientific_limitations: No claims for short b, arbitrary coordinate permutations, nonbinary Hamming codes, or unindexed priority. General proof relies on cyclic consecutive-column rank; finite verification reaches m=5 for short supports and m=4 for full enumerators.
scientific_scope: Binary cyclic Hamming codes with primitive-power cyclic coordinate ordering; integer b>n/2; complete b-symbol weight enumerators.
title: Geometric long-window \(b\)-symbol weight enumerators of cyclic binary Hamming codes
